title.en: Egg Packing and Order Records Assistant
title.zh: 鸡蛋包装与订单记录助理

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Pack released eggs using approved carton, grade and batch instructions.
requirements.zh: 依据获批纸盒、等级及批次说明包装已放行鸡蛋。

requirements.en: Maintain separate counts for filled product cartons and unused packaging, reporting damaged or unclear items.
requirements.zh: 分别维护装有产品的纸盒及未使用包装的数量，并报告损坏或不清晰事项。

requirements.en: Maintain order-dispatch references and clear packing-shift handovers.
requirements.zh: 维护订单发货编号及清晰包装轮班交接。
